description: This Java class defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot backend application, managing validation errors, response status exceptions, and generic exceptions, and returning standardized ProblemDetail responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles common exceptions and formats error responses in a Spring Boot REST application.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions and returns a ProblemDetail with validation errors.

methods.name: handleResponseStatus
methods.description: Handles ResponseStatusException and returns a ProblemDetail with the specific error status and reason.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions and returns a generic internal server error response.
